_comment: Raspberry Pi bridge settings. Copy to /etc/bioreactor-pi/config.json on the Pi and edit there. The reactor THRESHOLDS are not here: the Arduino keeps them in EEPROM (Temp Min / Temp Max / Overheat / Gas out alarm / Gas in pump) and they are changed from the dashboard (SET command) or on the Arduino's own screen.

serial._comment: port: "auto" = first /dev/ttyACM* or /dev/ttyUSB* (on Windows: first USB COM port), or an exact port like "/dev/ttyUSB0". A Mega with a CH340 chip is /dev/ttyUSB0.

simulator._comment: Virtual Arduino (--simulate and the laptop's СИМУЛЯТОР). mq_warmup_s is 60 on the real board; shorter here so a demo does not start with a minute of «warm-up».
